<EndpointMetadata metadata={{"method":"post","path":"/rest/api/v1/createauthtoken","api":"client","release":{"stage":"ga"},"authorization":{"schemes":["APIToken"],"header":"Authorization: Bearer <token>","tokenTypes":["OAuth access token","Glean-issued token"],"docsUrl":"/api-info/client/authentication/overview"},"scopes":null,"deprecations":[]}} />



Creates an authentication token for the authenticated user. These are
specifically intended to be used with the [Web SDK](https://developers.glean.com/web).

Note: The tokens generated from this endpoint are **not** valid tokens
for use with the Client API (e.g. `/rest/api/v1/*`).
